notes: Same group / subgroup IDs and names as v1. Enriched definition, include terms, exclusions, key provisions and anchors (IKP key prefixes used by the coverage check). New subgroups marked new: true.

groups.name: GOODS
groups.description: Transactions involving goods, grouped by commercial activity.

subgroups.name: Sale of Goods
subgroups.definition: Supply of movable goods by sale for a price or other consideration, including the conditions under which a sale of goods is a taxable supply.
exclude: Sale of land or buildings (not goods)
Sale of a whole business as a going concern (TSG09_01)

subgroups.name: Transfer of Goods / Title
subgroups.definition: Transfer of title, ownership, right or possession in goods, including transfer of title at a future date (hire purchase) and transfer of right to use without title.
include: title to pass at a future date
exclude: Transfer of a business as a going concern (TSG09_01)
Transfer of input tax credit between registrations (TG06)

subgroups.name: Barter & Exchange
subgroups.definition: Exchange or barter: goods or services given for other goods, services or any non-money value, and the rules that value such supplies where consideration is not wholly in money.
exclude: Return or replacement of defective goods under warranty (TSG01_07)

subgroups.name: Disposal / Gift / Free Supply
subgroups.definition: Permanent transfer or disposal of business assets, gifts and free supplies, including supplies treated as supply even without consideration.
exclude: Sale of business assets for a price (TSG09_03)
Blocked credit on gifts as such (TSG06_03) unless the atom is about the gift supply itself
key_provisions: Schedule I para 2 proviso (gifts up to Rs 50,000)

subgroups.name: Goods Movement & Delivery
subgroups.definition: Dispatch, transport, delivery and movement of goods, including goods sent on approval, supply on approval basis and goods moved without a supply.

subgroups.name: Job Work & Processing
subgroups.definition: Sending inputs or capital goods to a job worker for processing and bringing them back, and the procedure, time limits and liability for job work.
include: return of goods from job worker
exclude: Treatment or process as a service (TSG02_06)

subgroups.name: Goods Returns & Replacements
subgroups.definition: Return, rejection, replacement and exchange of goods already supplied, including sales returns that lead to credit notes.
exclude: Credit note documentation as such (TSG05_01, TSG14_04)

subgroups.name: Supply of Goods (General)
subgroups.definition: Recognition of an activity as a supply of goods (not services) under GST, including Schedule II classifications as goods and the definition of goods.
exclude: Activities treated as supply of services (TG02)

subgroups.name: Service Provision
subgroups.definition: Supply of services and performance of service obligations, including the definition of services and activities treated as supply of services.
exclude: Money and securities as such (excluded from goods and services)

subgroups.name: Rental / Lease / Licence
subgroups.definition: Renting, leasing, letting out, licensing and hire of goods or immovable property, and the tax treatment of such rights.
exclude: Sale of land or completed building (Schedule III)

subgroups.name: Construction & Works Contract
subgroups.definition: Construction of buildings and complexes, works contracts and related credit restrictions and classifications.
exclude: Sale of completed building after completion certificate (TSG03_05)

subgroups.name: Intellectual Property & Digital Services
subgroups.definition: Intellectual property rights, software, information technology and online / digital services (including OIDAR and online gaming).
exclude: Place of supply rules only (TSG08_03) unless about the digital service itself

subgroups.name: Financial & Intermediary Services
subgroups.definition: Banking, insurance, financial services, money changing, lottery / betting / gambling valuation and intermediary services.

subgroups.name: Treatment / Processing Services
subgroups.definition: Any treatment or process applied to another person's goods, which is a supply of services.
include: manufacturing service on goods owned by others
exclude: Supply of the processed goods themselves (TG01)

subgroups.name: Special Service Arrangements
subgroups.definition: Special and deemed services: services by employees, refraining from an act, tolerating a situation, food services, and other specially listed service forms.
include: use of business goods for private purpose

groups.name: DEAL STRUCTURE & SUPPLY EXCEPTIONS
groups.description: Supply forms and exceptions to ordinary supply assumptions.

subgroups.name: Supply With Consideration
subgroups.definition: Supply made or agreed to be made for a consideration, and the meaning of consideration as a condition of supply.
include: made or agreed to be made for a consideration

subgroups.name: Supply Without Consideration
subgroups.definition: Activities treated as supply even when made without consideration (Schedule I), including import of services from related persons.
include: treated as supply even if made without consideration

subgroups.name: Composite & Mixed Supply
subgroups.definition: Composite supply (naturally bundled, principal supply) and mixed supply (not naturally bundled, single price) and their tax treatment.

subgroups.name: Deemed Supply & Special Classifications
subgroups.definition: Transactions deemed to be supplies or specially classified as goods or services by the law (Schedule II, s.7(1A), s.7(3) notifications).
include: specified by notification as supply of goods

subgroups.name: Neither Supply / Schedule III
subgroups.definition: Activities or transactions treated neither as supply of goods nor of services (Schedule III, notified government activities).
include: neither as a supply of goods nor a supply of services
exclude: Exempt supplies that are still supplies (TSG12_05)

subgroups.name: Principal-Agent & Special Arrangements
subgroups.definition: Supplies between principal and agent and other special arrangements where goods move through an agent, auctioneer or pure agent.

subgroups.name: Business & Course or Furtherance of Business
subgroups.definition: The requirement that a supply is made or agreed to be made by a person in the course or furtherance of business, and the meaning of business.
include: Business & Course or Furtherance of Business
in the course or furtherance of business
by a person in the course of business
exclude: General business mentions without a legal requirement

groups.name: PRICE & CONSIDERATION
groups.description: Valuation and the money side of dealings.

subgroups.name: Monetary & Non-Monetary Consideration
subgroups.definition: Forms of consideration: money, non-money, barter, deposit applied as consideration, subsidies and the meaning of consideration.

subgroups.name: Transaction Value
subgroups.definition: Transaction value: the price actually paid or payable where supplier and recipient are not related and price is the sole consideration.

subgroups.name: Valuation Additions & Exclusions
subgroups.definition: Amounts to include in or exclude from value: taxes other than GST, incidental expenses, interest, late fee, subsidies, pure-agent costs.

subgroups.name: Discounts & Price Reductions
subgroups.definition: Discounts given before, at or after supply and the conditions for excluding them from value.

subgroups.name: Related-Party / Special Valuation
subgroups.definition: Valuation where price is not the sole consideration or parties are related or distinct, or supplies through an agent: Rules 27-31.
include: value of like kind and quality

subgroups.name: Currency & Valuation Methods
subgroups.definition: Specified valuation methods and conversions: exchange rate of foreign currency, value of money changing, air travel agents, vouchers, second-hand goods, tax-inclusive value.

groups.name: ADJUSTMENTS & AFTER-SALE EVENTS
groups.description: Adjustments arising after initial documents or transactions.

subgroups.name: Credit Notes
subgroups.definition: Credit notes for excess value or tax charged, returned goods or deficient services, their time limit and tax effect.

subgroups.name: Debit Notes
subgroups.definition: Debit notes where the taxable value or tax charged is less than payable, and their tax effect.

subgroups.name: Cancellation & Sales Returns
subgroups.definition: Cancellation of supplies, returns of goods and reversal of a supply already made or invoiced.

subgroups.name: Price / Quantity Corrections
subgroups.definition: Correction of price, quantity, rate or value after invoicing, including revised invoices.

subgroups.name: Advances & Subsequent Adjustments
subgroups.definition: Advances received before supply, receipt vouchers, refund vouchers and adjustment of advances against later supplies.
exclude: Time of supply rules on payment (TSG13_03)

subgroups.name: Write-Offs & Other Adjustments
subgroups.definition: Write-offs, destruction, loss, theft and other post-transaction adjustments with GST consequences.

groups.name: PURCHASE & CREDIT
groups.description: Inward supplies and input tax credit.

subgroups.name: Inward Supply / Purchase
subgroups.definition: Inward supplies, purchases and the definitions of input, input service, capital goods and input tax.

subgroups.name: ITC Eligibility
subgroups.definition: Eligibility and conditions for taking input tax credit: tax invoice, receipt, tax paid by supplier, return filed, time limit.

subgroups.name: Blocked & Restricted Credit
subgroups.definition: Credits that are blocked or restricted: motor vehicles, food, club membership, construction, personal use, lost / gifted goods, composition tax.

subgroups.name: ITC Apportionment
subgroups.definition: Apportionment of credit between business and non-business use and between taxable and exempt supplies, and the value of exempt supplies.

subgroups.name: ITC Reversal & Reclaim
subgroups.definition: Reversal of credit (non-payment within 180 days, exempt use, cancellation, composition switch) and re-availment.

subgroups.name: ITC Reconciliation & Matching
subgroups.definition: Matching and reconciliation of credit with supplier returns and auto-generated statements (GSTR-2A / 2B).

subgroups.name: Input Service Distribution
subgroups.definition: Distribution of credit by an Input Service Distributor and recovery of excess distribution.
exclude: Transfer of credit on business transfer (TG09)

subgroups.name: Capital Goods & Job-Work ITC
subgroups.definition: Credit on capital goods and on inputs / capital goods sent to job workers.
include: supply of capital goods on which credit taken

subgroups.name: Transitional Credit
subgroups.definition: Transitional credit: carrying forward CENVAT / VAT credit and stock credit from the earlier law into GST.
include: credit on stock held on appointed day

subgroups.name: B2B / B2C Transactions
subgroups.definition: Treatment that depends on whether the recipient is registered (B2B) or unregistered / consumer (B2C).

subgroups.name: E-Commerce & Platforms
subgroups.definition: Supplies through electronic commerce operators: operator liability, TCS, compulsory registration and ECO definitions.

subgroups.name: Principal & Agent
subgroups.definition: Agents and principals as parties: registration of agents, liability of agent and principal.

subgroups.name: Related / Distinct Persons
subgroups.definition: Related persons and distinct persons (establishments with separate registrations) and supplies between them.

subgroups.name: Government & Specified Recipients
subgroups.definition: Supplies by or to Government, local authorities, UN bodies, embassies and specified recipients.

subgroups.name: TDS / TCS Participants
subgroups.definition: Persons who must deduct tax at source (TDS) or collect tax at source (TCS) and their duties.

subgroups.name: Special Supplier / Recipient Categories
subgroups.definition: Special statutory classes: casual taxable person, non-resident taxable person, OIDAR supplier, ISD, Government, SEZ unit.

groups.name: LOCATION & BORDER TRANSACTIONS
groups.description: Geography, place of supply and cross-border dealings.

subgroups.name: Intra-State & Inter-State Supply
subgroups.definition: Whether a supply is inter-State or intra-State, including supplies in territorial waters.
include: place of supply in a different State

subgroups.name: Place of Supply — Goods
subgroups.definition: Place of supply of goods (movement, delivery to third party, assembly, on board conveyance, import / export).

subgroups.name: Place of Supply — Services
subgroups.definition: Place of supply of services (general rule and specific services, inside and outside India).

subgroups.name: Imports
subgroups.definition: Import of goods and services, IGST on imports, and import of services by related persons.

subgroups.name: Exports & Zero-Rated Supplies
subgroups.definition: Exports of goods and services and zero-rated supplies, LUT / bond and export refunds.

subgroups.name: SEZ & Deemed Exports
subgroups.definition: Supplies to or by SEZ units / developers and deemed exports.

subgroups.name: Warehousing / High-Seas / Special Territories
subgroups.definition: Warehoused goods, high-seas sales, supplies outside India and other special territorial situations.

subgroups.name: Business Transfer / Sale
subgroups.definition: Transfer of a business as a whole or of an independent part, as a going concern or otherwise, and transfer of credit and liability.
include: transfer of credit on business transfer

subgroups.name: Merger / Amalgamation
subgroups.definition: Mergers, amalgamations and demergers and the resulting liability and credit.

subgroups.name: Business Assets & Capital Goods
subgroups.definition: Business assets and capital goods: supply, transfer, disposal and use of business assets.

subgroups.name: Business Closure / Liquidation
subgroups.definition: Closure, discontinuance, liquidation and winding up of business and the GST consequences.

subgroups.name: Succession & Representative Liability
subgroups.definition: Liability of successors, legal representatives, directors, partners, guardians, trustees and courts of wards.

subgroups.name: Change in Ownership / Constitution
subgroups.definition: Change in constitution, ownership, partners or details of a business and its effect on registration and liability.

groups.name: NON-COMPLIANCE & REMEDIES
groups.description: Enforcement, tax demands and dispute remedies.

subgroups.name: Scrutiny & Assessment
subgroups.definition: Self-assessment, provisional assessment, scrutiny of returns, best-judgement, summary and unregistered-person assessment.

subgroups.name: Audit & Investigation
subgroups.definition: Audit by tax authorities and special audit, and investigation of records.

subgroups.name: Tax Demand & Recovery
subgroups.definition: Determination of tax not paid or short paid, demand notices, recovery proceedings, attachment and first charge.

subgroups.name: Interest / Late Fees / Penalties
subgroups.definition: Interest on delayed payment, late fees and penalties, including general penalty and waiver.

subgroups.name: Detention / Seizure / Confiscation
subgroups.definition: Detention, seizure, release and confiscation of goods and conveyances in transit.

subgroups.name: Offences & Prosecution
subgroups.definition: Offences, prosecution, arrest, cognizance, culpable mental state and compounding of offences.

subgroups.name: Appeals / Revision / Judicial Remedies
subgroups.definition: Appeals to Appellate Authority and Tribunal, revision, High Court and Supreme Court, pre-deposit and non-appealable decisions.

subgroups.name: Rectification & Dispute Resolution
subgroups.definition: Rectification of errors apparent on record, and dispute-settlement procedures.
include: error apparent on the face of record

subgroups.name: Inspection, Search & Summons
subgroups.definition: Inspection, search, seizure of documents, summons to give evidence, access to premises and officers to assist.

subgroups.name: Anti-Profiteering
subgroups.definition: Anti-profiteering: passing on the benefit of rate reduction or credit to recipients, the authority and its procedure.
include: benefit of input tax credit passed on

groups.name: TAXPAYER & PROCESS CONTROL
groups.description: Who is registered, taxpayer status, procedural governance.

subgroups.name: Registration & GSTIN
subgroups.definition: Liability to register, threshold, compulsory registration, procedure, GSTIN, cancellation and revocation.

subgroups.name: Taxpayer Type / Status
subgroups.definition: Status of a taxpayer: registered, unregistered, deemed registration, persons not liable, special status.

subgroups.name: Composition & Special Taxpayer Schemes
subgroups.definition: Composition levy and other special schemes: eligibility, conditions, rates, switch-over and returns.
include: bill of supply by composition dealer

subgroups.name: Compliance Periods & Deadlines
subgroups.definition: Tax periods, due dates and time limits for compliance and extension of time limits.

subgroups.name: Procedural Applications & Permissions
subgroups.definition: Applications, permissions and procedural requests on the common portal (forms, verification, approval).

subgroups.name: GST Practitioners & Representatives
subgroups.definition: GST practitioners: enrolment, authorisation, conditions and duties.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Procedural Evidence & Proof
subgroups.definition: Evidence, burden of proof, presumptions about documents and admissibility of records.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Common Portal & GSTN
subgroups.definition: Common portal, GST Network, electronic filing infrastructure, compliance rating and information returns.

subgroups.name: Casual & Non-Resident Taxable Persons
subgroups.definition: Casual and non-resident taxable persons: registration validity, advance deposit and special returns.

groups.name: TAXABILITY, RATES & EXEMPTIONS
groups.description: Whether and how a tax charge arises, and at which rate.

subgroups.name: Taxable / Non-Taxable Supply
subgroups.definition: Whether a supply is taxable, exempt, nil-rated or non-taxable (e.g. alcoholic liquor for human consumption).

subgroups.name: GST Levy & Tax Head
subgroups.definition: The charging provision: levy of CGST / SGST / IGST, who collects, and on what value and rate.

subgroups.name: HSN / SAC Classification
subgroups.definition: HSN and SAC classification of goods and services and its use in invoices and returns.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: GST Rates & Rate Conditions
subgroups.definition: Tax rates, rate notifications and the conditions attached to a rate.
include: rate not exceeding twenty per cent
on the recommendations of the Council rate

subgroups.name: Exemptions & Concessions
subgroups.definition: Power to exempt and exemption notifications, absolute or conditional, and concessions.

subgroups.name: Reverse Charge / Special Levy
subgroups.definition: Reverse charge: recipient liable to pay tax, notified supplies, supplies from unregistered persons, ECO liability.

subgroups.name: Compensation Cess
subgroups.definition: GST compensation cess on specified goods and services.

subgroups.name: Special Rate / Levy Treatment
subgroups.definition: Special levies and treatments: petroleum products from a notified date, special procedures, sector-specific regimes.

groups.name: TIME OF SUPPLY & TAX LIABILITY EVENTS
groups.description: Timing of liability, rate changes, trigger events.

subgroups.name: Time of Supply — Goods
subgroups.definition: Time of supply of goods: invoice date, payment date, reverse charge, vouchers and residual rule.

subgroups.name: Time of Supply — Services
subgroups.definition: Time of supply of services: invoice, payment, completion, reverse charge, associated enterprises.

subgroups.name: Advance / Receipt / Payment Events
subgroups.definition: Timing of advances, receipts and payments as liability events.

subgroups.name: Change in Tax Rate
subgroups.definition: Time of supply when the rate of tax changes.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Tax Liability Trigger & Tax Period
subgroups.definition: When liability to pay tax arises and the tax period in which it falls, including continuous supply.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Special Timing & Deferment
subgroups.definition: Special timing, deferment and deemed dates (goods on approval, vouchers, residual cases).
include: where it is not possible to determine
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

groups.name: DOCUMENTS, RETURNS & RECORDS
groups.description: Issuing documents, reporting transactions and keeping records.

subgroups.name: Tax Invoices / Bills of Supply
subgroups.definition: Tax invoice and bill of supply: when to issue, contents, time limit and prohibition of unauthorised collection.
include: time limit for issue of invoice

subgroups.name: E-Invoicing / IRN
subgroups.definition: Electronic invoicing: invoice reference number (IRN), QR code, notified class of persons.

subgroups.name: E-Way Bills / Transport Documents
subgroups.definition: E-way bills and transport documents: generation, validity, verification and documents to be carried.

subgroups.name: Credit / Debit Note Documentation
subgroups.definition: Documentation and reporting of credit and debit notes (particulars, declaration in returns).
exclude: Tax effect of credit / debit notes (TSG05_01, TSG05_02)

subgroups.name: Outward & Inward Return Reporting
subgroups.definition: Reporting of outward and inward supplies (GSTR-1, communication to recipient).

subgroups.name: Periodic / Annual Returns & Reconciliation
subgroups.definition: Periodic, final and annual returns, reconciliation statements and notices to non-filers.

subgroups.name: Accounts, Books & Record Retention
subgroups.definition: Accounts and records: what to keep, where, electronic records and retention period.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Notices, Declarations & Certificates
subgroups.definition: Notices, declarations, certificates, service of notice and publication of information.

groups.name: PAYMENTS, LEDGERS & REFUNDS
groups.description: Tax settlement, tax ledgers and refund process.

subgroups.name: Tax Payments & Due Amounts
subgroups.definition: Payment of tax, interest, penalty and other dues, and the order of discharge.

subgroups.name: Electronic Cash / Credit / Liability Ledgers
subgroups.definition: Electronic cash ledger, electronic credit ledger and electronic liability register.

subgroups.name: ITC Utilisation & Offsetting
subgroups.definition: Utilisation and order of set-off of input tax credit and restrictions on use of credit.

subgroups.name: TDS / TCS Payments & Credits
subgroups.definition: Payment of TDS / TCS to Government and credit of it to the deductee / supplier.

subgroups.name: Refund Eligibility & Applications
subgroups.definition: Refund eligibility and application: who may claim, time limit, documents, unjust enrichment.
include: two years from the relevant date

subgroups.name: Refund Processing / Withholding / Interest
subgroups.definition: Refund processing: provisional refund, order, withholding, interest on delayed refund and Consumer Welfare Fund.

subgroups.name: Payment Corrections & Transfers
subgroups.definition: Corrections and transfers of tax paid: wrong head, transfer between registrations or cash ledgers.
include: integrated tax paid instead of central tax
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Recovery Payments / Instalments
subgroups.definition: Payment of dues in instalments and recovery accounting.

groups.name: LEGAL AUTHORITY, INTERPRETATION & CHANGES
groups.description: Definitions, authority, amendments and changing legal effect.

subgroups.name: Legal Definitions & Interpretation
subgroups.definition: Definitions and interpretation of terms used in the Acts, Rules and notifications.
include: in this Act, unless the context otherwise requires
exclude: Operative rules that use a defined term

subgroups.name: Government / Officer Powers
subgroups.definition: Powers and appointment of officers, Commissioner and Government, and protection of action in good faith.

subgroups.name: Notifications & Delegated Authority
subgroups.definition: Notifications and delegated authority: power to notify, regulations, laying before Parliament, delegation of powers.
include: laid before each House of Parliament

subgroups.name: Circulars / Clarifications / Instructions
subgroups.definition: Circulars, orders, instructions and clarifications issued for uniformity in implementation.

subgroups.name: Advance Rulings & Binding Effect
subgroups.definition: Advance ruling: authority, application, questions admissible, binding effect, appeals and void rulings.

subgroups.name: Amendments / Substitutions / Omissions
subgroups.definition: Amendments, substitutions, insertions and omissions of provisions, with their amending instrument and effective date.

subgroups.name: Commencement / Effective Dates / Savings
subgroups.definition: Commencement, extent, effective dates and saving of earlier actions.
include: extends to the whole of India

subgroups.name: Rule-Making / Cross-Law Application
subgroups.definition: Power to make rules and application of one law's provisions to another (IGST applying CGST provisions).
include: provisions of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act shall apply

subgroups.name: Repeal & Transitional Law
subgroups.definition: Repeal of earlier laws, savings and transitional continuance of proceedings.

subgroups.name: Removal of Difficulty Orders
subgroups.definition: Removal of difficulty orders issued by the Government to give effect to the Act.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

groups.name: GOVERNMENT REVENUE & INTERGOVERNMENTAL SETTLEMENT
groups.description: Statutory revenue allocation and governmental settlement.

subgroups.name: IGST Apportionment & Settlement
subgroups.definition: Apportionment of IGST and settlement of funds between the Centre and States.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Central / State / UT Tax Transfers
subgroups.definition: Transfer of tax amounts between Central, State and UT accounts.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Compensation to States
subgroups.definition: Compensation payable to States for loss of revenue.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Compensation Cess Fund & Distribution
subgroups.definition: Compensation cess fund: crediting and distribution.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Intergovernmental Revenue Accounting
subgroups.definition: Accounting and settlement of revenue between governments.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

subgroups.name: Statutory Revenue Allocation
subgroups.definition: Constitutional / statutory allocation of tax receipts.
exclude: Incidental mention without a rule or legal effect concerning this subgroup.

groups.name: OTHERS / UNMAPPED LEGAL CONCEPTS
groups.description: Fallback topics supported by a legal provision but not substantively covered by any of the original 17 GST groups. Never use merely because the initial embedding shortlist missed a relevant existing subgroup.

subgroups.name: Unlisted Forms of Supply
subgroups.definition: Non-exhaustive, unlisted qualifying forms of supply permitted by 'such as' when no supply-form subgroup covers the statement.
exclude: Named sale, transfer, barter, exchange, lease, rental, licence, disposal (use those subgroups)
